newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cerj 9-mo loss 126 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cerj 9-mo loss 126 mln reais.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state power utility Cerj, due to be privatized on November 20, said it had losses of 126.2 million reais between January and September, against a 63.8 million real loss in the same period a year ago.
The company noted its results were hurt badly earlier this year by a sale of debt paper at a discount.
Excluding this transaction, the firm's losses were 28.693 million reais in the period, it said.
Cerj financial director Claudio Bentes said the company showed improvements in its operating results. Cerj reported a 4.5 million real operating loss, against a 43.1 million real loss a year ago.
The company also said its net operational revenues totalled 339.5 million reais in the January-to-September period, up from 253.063 million reais in the same period 1995.
